question: Whether enforceable effluent limitations, monitoring requirements, and other permit conditions that govern compliance evaluation during Federal FY2025 are limited to those set forth in Part I, Part II, Part III, and Part IV of this permit (together with conditions stated on the cover page itself), excluding requirements that appear only in other permit sections or in related supporting documents not enumerated on the cover page.
semantic_arguments: The authorization is conditioned on compliance 'in accordance with this cover page and the effluent limitations, monitoring requirements, and other conditions set forth in Part I, Part II, Part III, and Part IV hereof.'

The cover page enumerates Parts I through IV as the referenced source of effluent limitations, monitoring requirements, and other conditions, without listing additional permit sections or external documents.
The passage distinguishes effluent limitations, monitoring requirements, and other conditions as separate referenced governing categories.
Related document locators in the passage context (statement of basis and fact sheet documents for Farmington, Aztec, and GCC) are not included in the cover-page enumeration of governing Parts I–IV.
notes: Purpose A depends on which numeric limits are applicable; Purpose B on which monitoring requirements are applicable; Purpose C on what evidence establishes missing-result states. A different reading of whether governing requirements are confined to the cover-referenced Parts I–IV versus also drawn from unlisted sections or supporting documents would change which limits, obligations, and evidence categories enter each computation.
